title: LFG No. 1: 20+ launches, 200K stars, and the best things you built with Firecrawl
summary: The first issue of LFG, our monthly newsletter: live flight tracking, UltraSearch, Firecrawl Local, six new Alexandria sources and the best community builds.
body_markdown:
This is the first LFG, our monthly newsletter.


We've shipped 20+ launches since mid-October, and each one gives your agent something new it can do. LFG brings them together in one place each month, along with the best things people built with Firecrawl and a prompt to try. Here's November.


## Live flight tracking for agents


Your AI agents can now track 100,000+ flights a day, see delays and cancellations at 3,900+ airports, and check ground stops and security lines right now. Check before heading home for the holidays.


With the Firecrawl plugin connected, try asking your agent:


> Is my 6:40 flight out of Denver tonight on time? And how bad is security there right now?


[Try flight tracking](https://alexandria.firecrawl.dev/go/flights) or[read the launch post](https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/live-flight-tracking-for-ai-agents) .


## UltraSearch


Search results usually hand your agent a list of links and leave the rest to it. UltraSearch returns the data alongside the results: records on 250M+ people, 75M+ companies and 150K+ stocks with live prices. Your agent gets the answer and the record behind it in one call.


With the Firecrawl plugin connected in Claude or ChatGPT, try:


> Use Firecrawl to find AI startups in Toronto that raised a Series A in the last 6 months. For each one, give me headcount, total funding and a link to the source.


[Try UltraSearch](https://alexandria.firecrawl.dev/go/ultrasearch) .


## More from November


- **[Firecrawl Local](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/firecrawl-local) :** Rebuilt in Rust for your machine. 37x faster than self-hosting, 230x less memory, fully open source.
- **[Podcasts in Alexandria](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/alexandria-podcasts) :** 4M+ episodes, 150K+ new every week. Every take the day it airs, quoted and timestamped.
- **[Firecrawl MCP v3](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/firecrawl-mcp-v3) :** 3,300+ tools with automatic provider waterfalls, 60x higher rate limits and parallel subtasks.
- **[Firecrawl plugin for Grok Bot](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/grok-bot-mcp) :** Grok users now get our 3,300+ data tools, indexes and the live web.


## Built with Firecrawl


The best part of the month was watching what you made.


- **[Setup guide for Alexandria in Claude and ChatGPT](https://www.kevinsingh.com/p/firecrawl-alexandria-in-claude-and) :** Four ready-to-use prompts for research, due diligence, compliance and lead lists.
- **[Live web access for sandboxed agents](https://www.docker.com/blog/docker-sandboxes-firecrawl-web-access/) :** Docker Sandboxes reach the web through one allowed host.
- **[A Herdr setup for parallel research](https://medium.com/@info.booststash/firecrawl-for-ai-agents-in-2026-pricing-limits-and-a-herdr-setup-for-parallel-research-6caf8fc937c6) :** Wires our CLI into a team of research agents.
- **[Alexandria vs. Treg for people search](https://apidog.com/blog/firecrawl-alexandria-vs-treg/) :** A head-to-head comparison.
- **[How I use Claude to find the right person to email](https://www.reddit.com/r/B2BSaaS/comments/1xuck29/how_i_use_claude_to_find_the_right_person_to/) :** A community member's outreach workflow.


Made something with Firecrawl?Send us the link and it might be in next month's LFG.


## 200K GitHub stars


We passed 200K stars on[GitHub](https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl) . Thank you to everyone who starred the repo, filed an issue or sent a PR.


## Six new sources in Alexandria


Alexandria is our library of sources your agent can read, cite and act on. New this month:


- **[SEC filings](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/sec-filings) :** 10-Ks, 8-Ks, insider trades and 13F holdings for 8,000+ public companies.
- **[Election Records](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/election-records-launch) :** Results, campaign funding and voting records for all 470 House and Senate races.
- **[Gov & Legal Index](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/government-legal-index) :** Statutes, regulations, local codes and court opinions from 30M US government pages.
- **[Life sciences research](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/life-sciences-research) :** Answers on drugs, diseases and genes from 41M+ papers.
- **[Cybersecurity data](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/cyber-security-data-pack) :** 400,000+ vulnerabilities, so coding agents can check and patch your dependencies.
- **[Directory](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/introducing-directory) :** Describe a role and get a shortlist from 250M+ profiles.


## Also shipped


- **[Company data for 75M+ companies](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/company-data-relaunch) :** Headcount, revenue, funding and tech stack in about half a second.
- **[Job search tools for ChatGPT and Claude](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/job-tools) :** Match a resume to 7M+ open roles, then find who to email.
- **[AI/ML Research Index](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/ai-ml-research-index) :** Find the right paper, even one posted today, and read the full text.
- **[Headless Clay for agents](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/headless-clay) :** Run your enrichment flows in ChatGPT and Claude, with 1,000 free credits a month.
- **[Firecrawl in eve](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/eve-integration) :** One command gives agents built on Vercel's open-source framework the web and Alexandria.
- **[Firecrawl for Google Cloud](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog/google-cloud-launch) :** Web and Alexandria data for Gemini and ADK agents.


Every launch is in the[changelog](https://www.firecrawl.dev/changelog) .


## Worth reading


Our white paper,[AI's Search-Bar Problem](https://www.firecrawl.dev/whitepapers/ais-search-bar-problem.pdf) , looks at why most teams still use AI like a search bar, and what changes when you hand agents whole jobs and the sources to do them. One finding: agents using Alexandria scored 21% higher on answer quality than agents using built-in web tools.


From the blog:


- [What is Alexandria, in plain English](https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/what-is-alexandria)
- [How to build a Black Friday price tracker](https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/black-friday-price-tracker)
- [Replacing Google Custom Search](https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/google-search-json-api-alternative)


## Around the office


We[opened an office in Toronto](https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/firecrawl-comes-to-toronto) . If you're nearby, come say hi. And[we're hiring](https://www.firecrawl.dev/careers) .


That's November. See you next month.


Laura + the Firecrawl team


*This month, LFG stood for Large Fetch Generation.*
